sections.title: Part Ⅰ TASK A. Readback and Hearback

body.label: ATC
body.text: HL123, clear direct ATLAS.

body.label: ATC
body.text: HL123, stop climb at flight level 260 due to traffic.

body.label: ATC
body.text: HL123, caution wake turbulence, runway 32 cleared for takeoff.

body.label: ATC
body.text: HL123, start up and pushback approved, long pushback, tail east until abeam gate 34.

sections.title: Part Ⅰ TASK B. Checking, Clarifying, Confirming, Informing

body.text: During your takeoff roll, you noticed bird activity at the end of the runway. Make a report after airborne to ATC.

body.label: ATC
body.text: HL123, go ahead.
While maintaining flight level 310, you are at Mach 0.81, from previous ATC instructions. You are also approaching the boundary of the FIR. Now ATC contacts you. Respond accordingly.

body.label: ATC
body.text: HL123, descend and maintain flight level 220. Contact Tokyo Control on 121.65. Report speed.
You are cruising at flight level 210. You have encountered moderate turbulence for 3 minutes with an altitude gain of around 200 feet. Now ATC contacts you. Respond accordingly.

body.label: ATC
body.text: HL123, request flight condition.

After becoming airborne, you contact Departure Control. ATC gives you climbing restrictions to cross Johnson VOR, but you cannot comply due to performance reasons. Acknowledge and respond accordingly.

body.label: ATC
body.text: HL123, climb and maintain flight level 210. Cross Johnson VOR at or above flight level 150. If unable, maintain flight level 130 until Johnson VOR.
ATC instructs you to make a 10-degree right turn for traffic separation. You misunderstood the instruction and made a 10-degree left turn. Now ATC contacts you. Respond accordingly.

body.label: ATC
body.text: HL123, confirm maintaining 10 degrees to the right of your route?

During an en-route phase of the flight, you are instructed to pass FRISO at 0100 Zulu, but the flight computer shows that, even at maximum speed, the aircraft will not cross FRISO until 0103 Zulu. Now ATC contacts you. Respond accordingly.

body.label: ATC
body.text: HL123, cross FRISO at or before 0100 Zulu.

sections.title: Part Ⅱ TASK A. Role-play & Follow-up

pre.text: Flight Paths In this scenario, you'll be the pilot flying Hotel Lima 123, which goes through three flight stages. Clearance, Apron, and Taxi.
Initial Situation You are ready for clearance to Smith Airport. You may need to inquire about additional information.

body.text: Contact Clearance Control and make a request.
Listen to the controller's message. Advise that you are ready.

body.label: ATC
body.text: HL123, for route revision. Advise when you're ready to copy.
Listen to the controller and give a full readback.

body.label: ATC
body.text: HL123, cleared to Smith Airport, HAPIE 3 departure. Expect fly runway heading until the Smith 1.5 DME, and then a right turn heading 100 to HAPIE, then as filed. Maintain 5,000. Expect flight level 350, 10 minutes after departure. Squawk 1766.
Listen to the controller's message. Respond accordingly, and inquire how long it will take.

body.label: ATC
body.text: HL123, readback is correct. Hold for release.

pre.text: Situation Update You are ready for pushback and startup. You are at gate Alpha 89. You experience a change in your plans.

body.text: Contact Apron and request pushback and startup.
Listen to the controller's response and give a full readback.

body.label: ATC
body.text: HL123, cleared pushback and startup. And once the tug crew gets you established on lane Alpha, if they can just pull you forward so I can push behind you at gate 87, I'd appreciate it.

pre.text: Situation Update You are still on the apron and realize that you have too much fuel. You will need to burn some off, or possibly defuel if able.

body.text: Contact Apron, report the problem, and request what you need.
Listen to the controller's message and respond accordingly.

body.label: ATC
body.text: HL123, roger. How long will that take? *(자막 손상 구간 — exam-spec §4-3 복원)*
Listen to the controller's message and respond accordingly.

body.label: ATC
body.text: HL123, defueling is not available here, and we are looking at about a 30-minute hold for you. *(자막 손상 구간 — exam-spec §4-3 복원)*

pre.text: Situation Update You have burnt off your extra fuel and are now holding short of Golf with information Alpha. There may be an alteration to your taxi route.

body.text: Contact Ground and request to taxi.
Listen to the controller's response and give a full readback.

body.label: Ground
body.text: HL123, Ground, runway 13 left, taxi left on Golf, cross runway 22 right, follow the Gulfstream passing left to right.
Listen to the controller's message. Respond accordingly and request assistance.

body.label: Ground
body.text: HL123, it appears the Gulfstream blew a tire. Are you able to continue straight on Golf 2, then left on Hotel?
You have just finished Task A, as the pilot of Hotel Lima one two three.
In this situation, what problem did you discover while on the ramp, and how did you resolve that problem?

sections.title: Part Ⅱ TASK B. Extended Role-play : Single Incident/Emergency Related

pre.text: Initial Situation You are the pilot of HL123, currently descending through flight level 180 to 11,000, approaching Public Airport. You have ATIS information Oscar.

body.text: Contact Public Approach and report your position.
Listen to the controller's response and respond accordingly.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, Public Approach, good afternoon. Descend and maintain 6,000, reduce speed to 210 and expect Dixie 1 arrival runway 23 transition, followed by ILS 23.

pre.text: Situation Update While descending and preparing for the approach, you have noticed that you have lost a lot of your instrument displays. The controller contacts you.

body.text: Respond accordingly, stating you're levelling off at 4,000. Inform them of your situation and request vectors for holding.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, turn right heading 190, descend and maintain 4,000 to intercept the runway 23 localizer.
Respond and give a full readback, and request weather information for Sovereign and Independent airports. You prefer VMC conditions.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, roger. Fly heading 270, maintain 4,000, and say intentions.
Request vectors to Independent Airport for a visual approach.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, Sovereign weather, wind 350 at 6, visibility 1 mile with ceiling 3,000 overcast, temperature 10, dewpoint 9. Independent looks better — wind 170 at 5, visibility 10, ceiling 2,200 broken, temperature 16, dewpoint 12.

pre.text: Situation Update As you start your turn towards Independent Airport, you get some instruments back that will allow you to shoot the ILS approach at Public Airport.

body.text: Contact Approach Control to give them an update of your situation, and request ILS 23 at Public Airport.
Respond and give a full readback. Advise approach to stand by for further information.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, roger. You're cleared to Public Airport. Turn right heading 140 and maintain 4,000. And let me know if anything changes.

How do you think the incident was handled by the air traffic controller? Do you feel the situation could have been handled differently? Make a comment from a pilot's point of view.
